correlation.name: Sutton-Graves stagnation-point convective heating correlation
correlation.source: NASA engineering implementation of the Sutton-Graves relation
correlation.original_reference: Sutton and Graves, NASA TR R-376, 1971

geometry.source: NASA Planetary Mission Entry Vehicle Quick Reference Guide Version 4.1

primary.interpretation: nominal body-scale continuum and hypersonic domain

nose_radius_sensitivity.interpretation: plus or minus 10 percent sensitivity is not an asserted Orion geometry uncertainty

velocity_assumption.interpretation: Earth-relative speed is used as the free-stream velocity approximation

interpretation_limits: The result is a low-fidelity engineering stagnation-point convective-heating estimate.
The result is MODEL-DERIVED and is not measured Artemis II heat flux.
The correlation uses a cold-wall approximation.
Finite wall temperature is not modeled.
Avcoat ablation and pyrolysis are not modeled.
Blowing and surface recession are not modeled.
Catalytic wall effects are not modeled.
Detailed shock-layer chemistry and chemical nonequilibrium are not modeled.
The 6.035 m nose radius is Orion EFT-1 heritage geometry and is not claimed as an Artemis II-specific as-flown effective stagnation radius.
Primary heat-load interpretation is restricted to Kn < 0.01 and Mach >= 5.
Kn < 0.001 and Mach >= 5 is retained as a stronger continuum sensitivity domain.
The full-trajectory Sutton-Graves integral is diagnostic only.
